shortDescription: Gather process, thread, and workload partition information using ps on AIX

options.name: all_64bit
options.description: Lists all 64-bit processes (-M). Allows performance analysis specific to 64-bit applications.

options.name: all_processes
options.description: Displays all processes currently on the system (-A). Includes both system and user processes. Useful for a complete view of system activity.

options.name: all_users
options.description: Displays only information about processes with the user ID numbers or login names that are specified for the Ulist variable(-U Ulist). The '-U' flag only applies to the current operating environment In the listing, the ps command displays the numerical user ID unless the '-f ' flag is used; then the command displays the login name. Lists numeric or textual user identifiers.

options.name: alt_name_list
options.description: Specifies an alternate system name list file (-n NameList). The operating system does not use the '-n' flag because information is supplied directly to the kernel..

options.name: concatenated_output
options.description: Determines whether to append or overwrite the output file. When true, new output is appended to existing logs.

options.name: descendants
options.description: Generates a list of descendants of every pid that has been passed to it in the 'pidlist' variable (-L pidlist). The list of descendants from all the given pid is printed in the order in which they appear in the process table.

options.name: exclude_kernel
options.description: Writes information to standard output about all processes, except kernel processes (-e).

options.name: exclude_session_leaders
options.description: Writes information to standard output about all processes, except the session leaders. Excludes session leaders from the process list (-d).

options.name: full_list
options.description: Generates a full-format listing (-f). Displays UID, PID, PPID, C, STIME, TTY, TIME, and CMD columns.

options.name: full_names
options.description: Prints all available characters of each user/group name instead of truncating to the first eight characters.(-X).

options.name: groups
options.description: Displays processes belonging to specific effective groups (-G Glist). Accepts group names or numeric GIDs (comma- or space-separated). Useful for filtering process ownership by Unix group.

options.name: kernel_processes
options.description: Displays only kernel processes (-k).

options.name: kernel_threads_processes
options.description: Displays kernel threads and associated processes (-m). Output lines for processes are followed by an extra output line for each kernel thread. Use with "-o THREAD" for thread-specific columns like TID, PRI, and SC.

options.name: long_list
options.description: Generates a long listing (-l). Provides extended columns such as F, s, UID, PID, PPID, C, PRI, NI, ADDR, SZ, PSS, WCHAN, TTY, TIME, and CMD fields..

options.name: no_thread_stats
options.description: Gathers no thread statistics (-N). With this flag, 'ps' reports those statistics that can be obtained by not traversing through the threads chain for the process. Useful when thread enumeration causes performance overhead.

options.name: output_format
options.description: Customizes output columns using a user-defined format string (-o Format). Accepts multiple field specifiers such as pid, user, pcpu, pmem, comm.

options.name: page_sizes_settings
options.description: Displays data, text, stack, and shared memory page size settings (-Z). Provides insight into page usage for memory analysis.

options.name: pids
options.description: Displays only processes with specified PIDs (-p Plist). Accepts one or more comma-separated process IDs. Provides focused information on specific target processes.

options.name: process_groups
options.description: Writes information only about processes that are in the process groups that are listed for the Glist variable (-g Glist). The Glist variable is either a comma-separated list of process group identifiers or a list of process group identifiers .

options.name: processes_on_terminals
options.description: Displays all processes associated with a terminal except session leaders (-a). Excludes background daemons or non-terminal processes. Helpful for viewing user-interactive processes only.

options.name: project
options.description: Displays the Project name, Project origin, and subproject identifier for the project. (-P). If the stick bit is set for the process, the project name is preceded by an asterisk '*' character. The Project origin field designates the currently loaded project repository (LOCAL or LDAP).

options.name: recorded_output
options.description: Specifies a file path to save the ps command output. If not provided, results are only returned in stdout.

options.name: sysv_format
options.description: Displays information in the System V format (-F format). Functions similar to the -o option but uses traditional System V field naming.

options.name: tree_pid
options.description: Displays the process hierarchy rooted at the given PID (-T pid). Uses ASCII art to show parent-child relationships. Commonly used for visualizing process trees.

options.name: ttys
options.description: Displays processes associated with specific TTY devices (-t Tlist). Accepts comma-separated or quoted terminal identifiers.

options.name: users_in_current_env
options.description: Displays processes owned by specific users in the current environment (-u Ulist). Accepts user names or numeric UIDs. Supports comma- or space-separated values up to 128 entries.
